title: Grateful Dead Live at Academy of Music on 1972-03-23

ai_review.summary: High‑quality soundboard capture of a partial show featuring a monster Dark Star and standout Two Souls in Communion.
ai_review.review: The recording is a clean soundboard source with only a faint buzz/hiss that doesn’t detract from the listening experience. Musically the highlight is an epic Dark Star – praised for its blissful jam and Phil’s bass frenzy – plus strong renditions of Two Souls in Communion, Truckin' and other classics, making the partial worth every download.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high praise for the Dark Star and overall show (≈4.6/5) combined with generally good soundboard quality (≈4/5) yields a weighted rating around 4.4; many detailed reviews give confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Slight buzz/hiss noted by a few reviewers but overall clear and balanced; the partial nature limits context but the audio is listenable and enjoyable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A short, partial set that centers on the Dark Star; despite being incomplete it flows well and showcases a high‑energy second‑half vibe.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for his playing ('great darkstar. thank you jerry') and overall contribution to the epic jam.
band_member_comments.Phil: Repeatedly highlighted for going berserk on bass during Dark Star; several reviewers call him 'the man' and note his dual‑verse vocals.
